positioning.job: print labels without granting excessive permissions
positioning.gap: no maintained free OSS alternative covers Web GUI, Python CLI, BLE connectivity, Classic Bluetooth SPP connectivity, and protocol documentation for the Fichero D11s

items.title: Verify Python CLI prints a label on a physical Fichero D11s
items.why: The candidate claims a working Python CLI but gate 2 must verify the round-trip works on hardware
items.acceptance: Running the CLI test command against a real printer produces a printed label
items.quote: The repository provides a working Python CLI, a web GUI, and protocol documentation, indicating a functional baseline.

items.title: Verify Web GUI loads and pairs via Web Bluetooth
items.why: The candidate advertises a Web GUI; it must be loadable and able to connect over BLE
items.acceptance: Opening the web app in a browser shows the interface and a BLE pairing prompt appears
items.quote: Candidate quotes: for 'Web-based graphical interface': "Web GUI"

items.title: Run existing test suite to confirm no regressions
items.why: The repository includes a tests directory; tests must pass before any changes
items.acceptance: All tests in the tests/ directory pass with the current dependencies
items.quote: repository root: .github, .gitignore, README.md, docs, fichero, pyproject.toml, tests, uv.lock, web

items.title: Pin all dependencies in pyproject.toml and verify uv.lock reproducibility
items.why: Clean dependencies are noted; pinning prevents future breakage
items.acceptance: uv sync --frozen succeeds and produces identical uv.lock on a clean machine
items.quote: the code appears maintainable with clean dependencies.

items.title: Add GitHub Actions workflow to run tests on every push
items.why: The .github directory exists but no CI is confirmed; automation prevents regressions
items.acceptance: A workflow in .github/workflows/ runs the test suite and reports success on the default branch

items.title: Add label template engine to Web GUI for non-technical users
items.why: Web GUI is a listed differentiator; templates extend its reach beyond developers
items.acceptance: Web GUI offers a template selector (address, QR, barcode) and prints a filled template without code
items.quote: Candidate quotes: for 'Web-based graphical interface': "Web GUI"

items.title: Release a versioned protocol specification document with changelog
items.why: Protocol documentation is a listed differentiator; versioning makes it a stable reference for other implementers
items.acceptance: docs/protocol-v1.0.md exists with a changelog section and is linked from README.md
items.quote: Missing capabilities: 'Web-based graphical interface', 'Python command-line interface', 'Bluetooth Low Energy connectivity', 'Classic Bluetooth SPP connectivity', 'Protocol documentation for reverse-engineered printer' (5 not covered by any maintained free OSS alternative).

must_beat.how_to_win: Support the Fichero D11s specifically (different printer) and provide Web GUI plus protocol documentation

must_beat.alternative: Hackaday article on Fichero reverse engineering
must_beat.how_to_win: Remain free, self-hostable, and under a permissive licence while the article is not an alternative with code

risks: Demand evidence is weak (score 1): only a single Hackaday mention and one comment
No moat (score 0): the reverse-engineered protocol and CLI can be replicated over a weekend
No monetization or distribution channel beyond open-source adoption (productization_path score 1)
Single printer model dependency: if Action discontinues the Fichero D11s, the user base evaporates

organised.detail: A test path is visible in the root, so gate 2's execution loop can verify the REVIVE stage.
